title: Long Grain Rice with Mustard Seeds
steps: Saute cumin and mustard seeds until you start to hear crackles, about 15-30 seconds.
Add the rice and continue to saute until the rice releases a nutty fragrance, about 60 seconds.  The color should remain mostly white, with a slight golden hue.
Transfer to a rice cooker, adding the water, garlic, salt, asafetida, and bay leaf.
Cook per rice cooker instructions.  (Cuckoo: mixed rice, turbo mode)
Fluff immediately when finished then close the lid and let rest for 10 minutes.
